author: Trash Theory
description: In music as in life, sometimes you make the wrong decision. A move that should propel a band to stardom snakes them back to square one. Changes in sound, image and personnel have all spelt the end for one band or another. And no one will know how any particular move will impact a career until it's already too late. In 1996 Sneaker Pimps were on the doorstep of success. Adopted by Modern Rock Radio and Buoyed to the mainstream in the wake of the Bristol Sound, they had celebrity fans, Hollywood soundtrack-placements and a shining future ahead of them. But then one false move screwed everything up. This is Alt Hit Wonders and this is the story of “6 Underground”.
title: Sneaker Pimps: The Definitive Story of 6 Underground - Alt Hit Wonders
